description: Input template for the selected Qa/SU3 color-connection or acyclic local-system torsion determinant. Fill only with data selected before comparison with the Qa residual.

mode_schema.eigenvalue: positive selected eigenvalue of the Qa/SU3 color threshold operator

torsion_schema.degree: form degree q in the selected acyclic complex
torsion_schema.zeta_derivative_at_zero: selected zeta'_q(0), or equivalent determinant finite part

no_knob_rules: The connection, local system, domain, and spectrum/torsion data must be selected before Qa/SU3 target comparison.
The template may not be filled by using the required residual -0.19453293407759187.
The canonical Nil Weitzenbock term and local FP/BRST quotient may not be counted a second time.
If using global_section_measure, the measure must be proven distinct from the local FP determinant.
remaining_required_data: selected SU3 color bundle or local system
selected connection/curvature/endomorphism or selected global measure
BRST physical domain and zero-mode/ghost rules
selected spectrum modes or analytic torsion finite parts
